summary: Full E2E test of 7 new Nugvio features (Action Center, Health Score Breakdown, Emergency Fund, Net Worth, Smart Alerts, Goals Autopilot, Weekly Recap) plus regression smoke. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass covering auth-required (401), shape/sort of insights, health-breakdown 6 components with correct max weights (25/20/20/15/10/10 = 100), emergency months=3/6/12 changes recommended, net worth structure (manual+auto assets + auto-investments + auto-goals + liabilities, net_worth math verified), assets POST/PATCH/DELETE persistence, alerts levels ∈ {risk,spending,goal}, goals-autopilot PATCH with linked SIP updates committed_monthly, recap contribution increases 'saved'. Old /api/health-score legacy shape still returned. Frontend: all data-testids verified on Dashboard (act-now-btn, dash-boost-score), Action Center (action-insights, insight-*, action-btn-* navigates, score-breakdown, 6 score-comp-*, score-target-card, 3 score-action-*), Emergency (months buttons flip recommended 6mo ₹27,734 → 12mo ₹55,468, contribute increased current 40,000→40,100), Net Worth (add asset ₹93,660→₹1,43,660, edit via prompt→₹1,68,660, delete restores to ₹93,660, auto-investments/auto-goals rows shown, liabilities-list rendered), Alerts bell opens panel with 2 items, Goals autopilot (4 goals, saving commit ₹2500→₹5000 updates committed line), Recap all 6 rows render + share copies text. Sidebar sections show nav-actions/nav-networth/nav-emergency/nav-recap. Regression: Dashboard, Expenses, Budgets, Investments, Debts load without page errors.

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render before ResponsiveContainer measures - cosmetic only, charts render correctly (noted in iter_2).

React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' logged. Source code is clean (<option>{s.name} ({inr(...)})</option>); the offending <span> is injected by Emergent dev-instrumentation (data-ve-dynamic / x-excluded). Not a user-code bug and won't reach prod build, but noisy in dev console.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1605 lines. Splitting into router modules (auth, expenses, budgets, investments, goals, wealth, insights) is overdue.

Net worth response mixes shapes vs the review spec: it returns {assets:{manual,auto,total}, liabilities:{items,total}, net_worth} (nested), while the review request described flat 'assets' and 'liabilities' arrays. UI handles it, but keep API doc/spec in sync.
Health breakdown returns 'points/max/pct' per component; review request mentioned 'weight'. Naming is fine (points/max is clearer) but ensure any external clients or docs use the actual field names.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents should set explicit min-height so initial render doesn't log width/height(-1) warnings.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data. Test-created TEST_ASSET / TEST_ASSET_X / TEST_UI_ASSET were cleaned up during tests. Goal autopilot commit for first goal was left at ₹2,500-₹5,000 (non-destructive; can be re-saved).
